bonuses.title: Your First Solo Trip After 50 — The Complete Plan
bonuses.description_html:
Plan your first solo trip after 50 with more confidence and less overwhelm. This 29-page PDF guide includes 10 destination ideas, an example budget, a printable budget planner, packing suggestions, safety guidance and planning checklists. You’ll also find personal advice on eating alone and handling lonely moments, plus worksheets to work through worries, prepare your arrival and record essential contacts.

Created by Angela Jane, founder of Travels of the World, drawing on her own solo travel experiences. Download, print and work through it at your own pace.
